dct_description_sm: All parcels within the City are classified according to 26 distinct existing land use codes. The data intends to represent the actual land uses existing on all parcels, current as of the date of the update (July 2025).
dct_rights_sm: The City of Mississauga (“the City”) attempts to keep the information current, accurate and complete but reliance upon any data shall be at your sole risk. All such information should be verified independently before being used or relied on. The City assumes no responsibility for any damages arising out of the use of this data. The data is provided “as is”. The City is the owner and sole proprietor of the GIS Data. The GIS data may not be modified or copied without written consent. This is not a plan of survey. This is for informational use only.
